text: 央行副行长邹澜15日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，人民银行将继续发挥好结构性货币政策工具等其他货币金融政策的作用。刚才我们光启司长也作了比较详细的介绍。要以金融供给侧结构性改革为主线，持续提升金融服务实体经济的质效，优化信贷结构。一方面，落实好年初出台的一系列结构性货币政策措施，不断完善工具设计和管理，必要时还可根据市场需求增加工具额度并优化政策要素，加力支持扩大内需、科技创新、中小微企业等重点领域。另一方面，引导金融机构科学评估风险，分类施策、有扶有控，提高资金使用效率。
text_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 15th that the central bank will continue to leverage structural monetary policy tools and other monetary and financial policies. He noted that Director Guangqi provided a detailed introduction earlier, and the focus will be on financial supply-side structural reform to enhance the quality and efficiency of financial services to the real economy and optimize credit structure. On one hand, it will implement a series of structural monetary policy measures introduced earlier this year, improve tool design and management, and increase tool quotas and optimize policy elements as needed to support areas like expanding domestic demand, tech innovation, and small and micro enterprises. On the other hand, it will guide financial institutions to scientifically assess risks, implement differentiated policies with support and control, and improve capital use efficiency.
